CREATE TABLE h (id int, a int, b int); CREATE FUNCTION h_f() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER h_t AFTER UPDATE OF a, b ON h FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.a IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.a) EXECUTE FUNCTION h_f();
